description: Searches Google News and returns up to 20 articles (title, url, source, published_at, snippet), localized by country and language. published_at is the source's own text and can be relative, such as "2 hours ago". It does not return article bodies (use scrape_url on an article url) and is not general web search (use google_search). Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the news, e.g. "it" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the articles, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer from 0: 0 is the first page, 1 the second, e.g. 1. Omit for the first page; each page is a separate charged call.

query.description: News search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "renewable energy policy".

results.description: Maximum articles returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: search_news
title: Search News
